Returns CPU profiling data. Available only when HTTPProfile is enabled in sink.conf.

params.name: profileType
params.description: The specific pprof data to retrieve (heap, goroutine, threadcreate, block, etc.), or a pattern matching multiple types.

items.docs: Serves various pprof data like heap, goroutine, threadcreate, block, and so on. The `{profileType}` path parameter can accept various profiling types as well as more complex patterns. Available only when HTTPProfile is enabled in sink.conf.
